_comment: Shared defaults. Your own budgets and limits go in settings.local.json (the Settings screen writes there; it is gitignored). account.label is auto-detected from ~/.claude.json. Account, billing period, plan limits and budgets. Anything set to null is reported by the dashboard as 'Unavailable from connected Claude data' rather than being invented.

limits._comment: Set these ONLY from your real plan. null => dashboard shows the metric as unavailable instead of guessing.

budgets._comment: Set your real budgets here. null => the dashboard reports 'No budget configured' instead of scoring you against an invented number.

waste_rules._low_output_note: Sessions are flagged when their output/billable ratio falls below this fraction of YOUR median session ratio, rather than an absolute number, because a healthy ratio depends on how agentic your workload is.

scorecard._comment: Reference points the 0-100 dimension scores are graded against. Derived from your own data by default; override to hold yourself to a different bar.
